hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if echo "$f" | grep -q '\.py$'; then pep=$(venv/bin/python3 -m pycodestyle --max-line-length=99 "$f" 2>&1); if echo "$pep" | grep -qv 'No module named\|No such file'; then if [ -n "$pep" ]; then jq -n --arg ctx "PEP 8 violations in $f:\n$pep" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":$ctx}}'; fi; fi; fi
